name: Proposals for decisions
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the EU Joint Undertakings for the financial year 2024
part_text:
**What this report does**

The European Parliament signs off how twelve EU research partnerships spent their 2024 money. These partnerships pool public and private cash in areas like aviation, hydrogen, rail, chips, computing and health. Auditors found the accounts reliable and the payments legal. Parliament still raises concerns: some partnerships leave large sums unspent, some private partners pay far less than promised, and staff cost claims by beneficiaries often contain errors. Parliament asks each partnership to report back by 30 September 2026 on how it fixes these problems.

**Key points**

- Parliament approves the 2024 accounts of all twelve partnerships and grants them discharge.
- Concerns: unspent cash, weak private contributions, repeated staff-cost errors, ITER delays and costs.
- Each partnership must send Parliament a signed follow-up report by 30 September 2026.
